Card Q&A.a: Yes. You don't have to place both a [SkullKnightmon] and a [DeadlyAxemon]. You can also place either of them on their own from either your hand or trash in this Digimon's digivolution cards.
Card Q&A.q: Can this card's [On Play] effect place cards in this Digimon's digivolution cards if I don’t have both a [SkullKnightmon] and [DeadlyAxemon] in either my hand or trash?

Card Q&A.a: Yes. You can mix and match [SkullKnightmon] and [DeadlyAxemon] from both your hand and trash to place in this Digimon’s digivolution cards.
Card Q&A.q: Can this card's [On Play] effect place a [SkullKnightmon] in my hand and a [DeadlyAxemon] in my trash in this Digimon’s digivolution cards?

Card Q&A.a: No. The effect reads, “you may,” so you can choose whether to play them. However, if both [SkullKnightmon] and [DeadlyAxemon] are in digivolution cards, you must choose to either play both of them or play none of them.
Card Q&A.q: If I have both [SkullKnightmon] and [DeadlyAxemon] in this Digimon’s digivolution cards, does this card’s [All Turns] effect require me to play both?

Effect: [On Play] You may place 1 [SkullKnightmon] and/or 1 [DeadlyAxemon] from your hand or trash under this Digimon in its digivolution cards in any order.
[All Turns] When this Digimon is deleted, you may play 1 [SkullKnightmon] and/or [DeadlyAxemon] from this Digimon's digivolution cards suspended without paying their memory costs.
